name: Colloquial
source:
Players play as a girl continuing her studies overseas. Suddenly, she receives a call from Japan that her father was hospitalized. Because of her father was in the hospital, she has to take over your father English Learning Center that is not doing so well. To make the center rise back up again, she join forces with the student and as well the teachers inside the center.

[Taken and edited from [url=https://www.gamerbraves.com/colloquial-makes-a-comeback/]GamerBraves[/url]]

Colloquial's service was terminated on July 15, 2019. A newer version, Re: Colloquial, carried on the story from the older version along new stories added to the game on a regular basis.

Re: Colloquial's service was terminated on September 26th, 2023.
translation:
玩家将扮演一名在海外继续求学的女孩。突然，她接到从日本打来的电话，得知父亲住院了。由于父亲无法工作，她不得不接手他那家经营不善的英语培训中心。为了让培训中心重振旗鼓，她与这里的学生和教师携手努力。

[根据[url=https://www.gamerbraves.com/colloquial-makes-a-comeback/]GamerBraves[/url]编辑整理]

《Colloquial》于2019年7月15日停止运营。新版《Re: Colloquial》承接了旧版的故事，并定期追加新剧情。

《Re: Colloquial》于2023年9月26日停止运营。
